message.text: A customer's email is written to the database unencrypted

snippet.text: await db.customers.insert({ email: body.email, name: body.name });

canyon.title: A customer's email is written to the database unencrypted
canyon.problem: customers.ts inserts body.email into the customers table as it came in. The rule asks that a customer's email is encrypted before it is stored.
canyon.fix: Encrypt the address with the app's field key before the insert, and decrypt it where it is read.
canyon.policy_name: Customer emails are encrypted at rest
canyon.required_end_state: No customer's email reaches a database column or a file unencrypted: every write of one passes through the app's encrypt step.
do_not: hash the address instead where the app needs to read it back
store it in another column or table unencrypted
